control.summary: Turn 1 of an exploration-only investigation (charter: no success_rules, no comparator). Waiting on three effect calls: (a) official scoring of the baseline predictions art_vp0 against art_task to establish a scorer-consistent baseline near the reported 0.84; (b) a train-only seed-11 reproduction on the active release 1.0.7 (job_0 used the older 1.0.4) to check reproducibility and to serve as the leak-free control arm; (c) the same seed-11 run with validation.npz and task.json staged, so that the delta between (b) and (c) reveals whether staged validation labels enter training. In parallel I author probe.py, a read-only introspector to be run inside the working copy next turn, which will report the working-copy file list, the project source text, installed packages, and the shape/dtype/value structure of every staged .npz/.npy/.json input, so a replacement project.py can be authored against the real data contract rather than guessed. Scope of this turn: measurement and reproduction only, no claim that the classifier has been improved; the improvement hypothesis (H4) will be tested in a later turn against a baseline scored by the same scorer on the same validation set, and any claim will be reported with its seed and configuration.
